Welcome. I’m so glad you’re here with me—because together, we’re about to step into a place where the ordinary has its own gentle magic. Imagine rural Indiana, where life in a small town is shaped by laughter, simple pleasures, and that quiet strength you only find in close-knit communities.
Picture open fields stretching out under big skies, familiar faces greeting you on every corner, and those little everyday moments—like stories told in kitchens or adventures down dusty roads—that somehow stick with you forever. Here, every neighbor’s tale becomes part of your own, and the tiniest events can turn into unforgettable memories.
Now, let’s see this world through the eyes of a spirited young girl, where mischief and wonder are never far away, and where the most unassuming places are filled with possibility.
Haven Kimmel’s book, A Girl Named Zippy: Growing Up Small in Mooreland, Indiana, pulls us right into this world. She brings to life the quirky characters, the family moments that make us smile, and those quiet reflections that remind us what it means to belong.
As we explore together, you’ll find laughter and longing woven side by side—childhood adventures that slowly open the door to bigger questions about faith, home, and who we really are.
So, let’s take a breath and get ready to revisit those days when the world felt safe, mysterious, and full of possibility. I can’t wait to discover these stories with you.
